release_notes:
1. Fix Add-to-Cart Product ID Leak: Completely eliminates cross-talk between related product carousels (e.g. Trink und Snack Tasse) and simple products. Strictly binds cart updates to added product identifiers.
2. Variant ID Sanitization: Ensures variant_id is strictly populated only when a genuine combination exists (ID > 0) and normalizes numeric zero to empty string for simple products.
3. Exact Selling Price Parity: Authoritatively pulls backend gross discounted consumer prices (e.g. 50% discount = 12.99 €) matching PrestaShop back office.
4. Robust Server Cart Matching: Pairs added cart item by both product ID and combination attribute ID directly from CartController response.
